_comment: Built-in 'never hide' list for the HOST detector: code identifiers and file names that end like an internal hostname. Matched case-insensitively against the whole match. This file is the single source: src/promptveil/detectors.py loads it, and scripts/build_extension.py copies it into web/index.html (and from there into extension/engine.js). Leave out names that could be real hosts, such as storage.local.
